subject: Coordinating: Multi-prospect demo — resolving overlapping availability
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@scaleuptools.com>, Tom Liu <tom.liu@novaprod.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Coordinating: Multi-prospect demo — resolving overlapping availability

Hi Alicia and Tom,

Thanks again for signing up for the group demo slot next week. We gathered a few more registrants and I wanted to confirm whether we should keep everyone together for a single 45-minute session or split into two focused 30-minute sessions (enterprise + mid-market). Right now several attendees' calendars overlap at the same 11:00–11:45 PT window.

Quick options:
- Option A: Keep a single 45-min group demo (concise product + Q&A).
- Option B: Split into two 30-min sessions back-to-back (shorter demos, more targeted Q&A).

If you have a preference, reply with A or B and any constraints (timezone / participant counts). If I don't hear back by EOD tomorrow I'll propose a fallback plan that reduces conflicts.

Attaching the draft agenda and I'll push an updated calendar invite once we settle on approach.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: multi-prospect-demo-invite.ics (calendar stub), redwood-demo-30min-agenda.pdf (one-page agenda)
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@scaleuptools.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: sales_ops@scaleuptools.com
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordinating: Multi-prospect demo — resolving overlapping availability

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the note — appreciate you coordinating. Quick heads up: our engineering lead (Tom) has a hard conflict at 11:00–11:45 PT on the 31st and won’t be able to attend if it stays as a single slot.

If you do Option B (split into two 30-min sessions), that would let Tom join the second block and our product team can attend the first. So I’m leaning B.

If splitting causes extra admin overhead for you, we can nominate a single attendee to take notes and share the recording.

—Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Director of Partnerships, ScaleUp Tools
alicia@scaleuptools.com

Kimberly — thanks for flagging. I think we should take Option B and run two focused 30-minute blocks. Operational notes: 

- Proposed times (PT): 11:00–11:30 (mid-market-focused demo) and 11:35–12:05 (enterprise-focused demo). Short 5-minute buffer for handoff.
- Ownership: I'll lead the mid-market demo; Kimberly you take enterprise and do the deep dive on routing/policy fallbacks. Grace can handle q&a triage and manage the recording.
- Calendar: I'll send two invites but will include a single ICS that contains both events for convenience (attendees can accept either).

Also, to reduce confusion we should add a subject prefix to the second invite: "Enterprise — Deep Dive". I'll populate the attendee list with company tags (ScaleUp Tools — Eng / ScaleUp Tools — Product) so they can self-select which invite to accept.

Grace — can you confirm you'll record and own the shared notes doc?

Ben
Ben Carter
Growth — Demo Ops
Redwood Inference

Hi all — appreciate the quick replies. We’ll go with Option B and run two short sessions on Tue, 31 Aug (PT):

- 11:00–11:30 PT — "Mid-market overview" (Ben leads)
- 11:35–12:05 PT — "Enterprise — Deep Dive" (Kimberly leads)

Grace confirmed she’ll record and post notes + recording to the shared doc after the session. Alicia / Tom — I added descriptive attendee tags in the invites so your teams can accept the slot that fits.

Calendar invites have been sent (link below) and I attached the one-page agenda. Please let me know if anyone needs a different timezone option and we can add an alternate replay slot.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-invite
Recording/Notes (post-demo): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/demo-notes

Thanks — see you on the 31st.
